input_contract.retrieval_statement: This model reads the values saved in the committed morning panel. Each key is resolved through the declared source catalogue (provider, series, transform and publication lag) and every value carries either a contemporaneous capture with a receipt taken at or before the cutoff, or an explicit reconstruction digest. The n8n Cloud child replays the saved values; it does not fetch history, so a replay alone never establishes historical availability.
input_contract.source_clock_policy: contemporaneous only when a capture at or before the cutoff matches the replayed value and carries a receipt id; otherwise reconstructed_panel with no receipt
input_contract.fill_policy: the controller never fills a missing value and never estimates one

keys.rule: VIX above 25 is safe-haven USD demand; below 16 is risk-on pressure
a 5-day VIX rise of more than one index point bids USD; a fall of the same size releases it
front-end yields up more than 5bp support USD; down more than 5bp oppose it
real yields up more than 5bp support USD; down more than 5bp oppose it
the dollar's own 5-day move continues: a rise above 0.15% is read as USD strength and a fall as weakness; FRED DTWEXBGS stands in for ICE DXY and is labelled as such everywhere
gold up more than 0.5% is a hedge bid against USD; down more than 0.5% is the reverse
equities up more than 0.5% is risk-on and reads against USD; down more than 0.5% reads for it
EUR/USD is USD inverted: a rise above 0.15% is read as USD weakness and a fall as USD strength; it stands in for the German 2-year leg the current model cannot reconstruct, and says so
USD/JPY is USD direct: a rise above 0.15% is read as USD strength and a fall as weakness
